scenario.topic: Pick a caterer for the annual holiday party
scenario.opening_question: What matters most for our holiday party catering: cost, menu variety, or ease of setup?

options.name: Gourmet Italian Platter by Bella Cucina
options.upside: High-quality authentic Italian dishes with included setup service
options.tradeoff: Limited to Italian cuisine which may not suit all tastes
options.concern: Some attendees might find the menu too heavy or carb-focused
options.best_for: prioritizing food quality and hassle-free setup

options.name: Healthy Mediterranean Buffet from Olive Grove
options.upside: Wide variety of healthy, fresh dishes with vegetarian options
options.tradeoff: No setup included, requiring extra time from the team
options.concern: Longer delivery time might delay the start of the party
options.best_for: prioritizing health-conscious and diverse menu options

options.name: Classic American BBQ by Smokey's Grill
options.upside: Fast delivery with hearty, familiar comfort food and full setup
options.tradeoff: Menu is less diverse and heavier, with limited vegetarian options
options.concern: Might be too casual or heavy for a weekday office event
options.best_for: prioritizing speed and traditional comfort food

options.name: Vegan Asian Fusion by Green Lotus Catering
options.upside: Unique, plant-based menu appealing to vegan and health-conscious guests
options.tradeoff: No setup service and some guests may prefer non-vegan options
options.concern: Preparation and setup might take time away from party activities
options.best_for: prioritizing dietary inclusivity and unique flavors
